# New Scope Buildout: Document Pipeline Automation Program

## Mission
Convert a newly signed statement of work into an execution-ready program plan for document pipeline automation.

## Scenario
Client signed a fresh scope to automate document intake, extraction, classification, and routing across three business units. You must stand up the program from zero.

## Deliverables
- Scope decomposition with workstreams, milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
- Detailed meeting cadence map (internal and client-facing), including agenda templates and decision rights.
- Communication matrix for leadership, delivery teams, and client stakeholders.
- Risk register with mitigation owners and escalation thresholds.
- First 30-day execution plan with staffing assumptions and readiness checks.

## Required AI Evidence
- AI workflow for decomposition, sequencing, and schedule risk forecasting.
- Validation checks for timeline feasibility and dependency realism.
- Three examples where AI suggestions were corrected due to domain constraints.
- Documentation automation system for recurring updates.

## Constraints
- Assume fixed budget with no immediate headcount increase.
- Client expects weekly executive visibility.
- Must include rollback logic for failed automation steps.
- Keep response under 950 lines.

## Submission Format
- Section A: Program summary and assumptions.
- Section B: Scope-to-workstream plan.
- Section C: Cadence and communication system.
- Section D: Risk and escalation framework.
- Section E: AI workflow evidence.

## Evaluation Criteria
- Execution readiness and sequencing quality.
- Strength of governance and communications design.
- Risk anticipation and mitigation depth.
- AI leverage quality in program setup.
